name: agent-sync
description: Sync coding-agent skills, memory and settings across machines and tools - path independent

commands.title: agent-sync: Link this folder to a project

agent-sync.syncRoot.description: Folder shared between your machines (Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, Syncthing).

agent-sync.machineId.description: Short name for this machine. Used in conflict filenames.

agent-sync.targets.description: Which agents to write context for. Pick from the list - no need to edit JSON by hand.

agent-sync.syncTranscripts.description: Sync Claude Code session transcripts so a project can be resumed from a different machine. Off by default: transcripts are large, grow without bound, and are not curated the way memory notes are.
